policy: Every required role must record an explicit, evidence-backed sign-off bound to the exact candidate commit, source tree and installer SHA-256. Owner-test requires owner-test roles; public-launch requires every role.

roles.accountableFor: Flow clarity, copy, keyboard/screen-reader access, contrast
roles.title: UX, content and accessibility

roles.accountableFor: Technical design, simplicity, dependency and data-flow soundness
roles.title: Architect

roles.accountableFor: Test strategy, installer behavior, artifact identity, release readiness
roles.title: QA and release owner

roles.accountableFor: Vets and recommends every customer-facing name, icon, image, theme and visual identity (incl. sign-in, installer, store, website) so each lands what Budlark is
roles.title: Marketing and visual brand

roles.accountableFor: Threat model, permissions, data handling, Defender/SmartScreen posture without bypass
roles.title: Security and privacy

roles.accountableFor: Terms, privacy policy, licenses, store policy
roles.title: Legal and compliance

roles.accountableFor: Positioning, website, download path, acquisition claims
roles.title: Growth and website

roles.accountableFor: Budlark voice, naming consistency, launch materials
roles.title: Editorial and brand

roles.accountableFor: Success metrics, privacy-respecting measurement, experiment readiness
